items.headline: Scheffler Tops 2026 PGA Tour
items.text: Scottie Scheffler leads the 2026 PGA Tour season-ending Tour Championship by three strokes last weekend.

items.headline: PGA Championship Buzz in Frisco
items.text: Momentum is building for the 2027 PGA Championship in Frisco, according to the PGA of America CEO.

items.headline: Gary Player Praises Scheffler
items.text: Golf legend Gary Player admires Scottie Scheffler’s game and character, highlighting his potential for consistent success.
